title: Gratitude, Perspective, and the Blessing of Unforeseen Outcomes
summary: Reflecting on the simple joy of rain, President Hughes highlights how gratitude acts as a lever for choosing happiness. Through an Arabic folk story about an old man's perspective on 'good luck' and 'bad luck,' he urges confined missionaries to withhold negative judgment on their current situation, promising that consistent righteousness and continuous good deeds will eventually bring great rewards.
